answer: An agent economy can bind identity to a hardware-rooted key stored in a ferrous cryogenic enclosure whose cavity resonance drifts uniquely with fabrication defects, much as a quill leaves a distinctive ink trail through karst terrain. Each epoch, agents must re-attest by measuring their cavity's dispersive shift against a registered baseline, so cloned identities fail the drift. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
